description: Defines the class 'data_flow_uplane_downlink_metrics_decorator', a decorator for measuring and collecting metrics related to downlink data flow in the Open Fronthaul User-Plane. It includes methods for enqueueing messages, collecting metrics, and managing internal counters.

classes.name: data_flow_uplane_downlink_metrics_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class that measures and collects performance metrics for downlink data flow.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a section type 1 message and measures resource usage.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector interface.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Aggregates and resets collected metrics, storing results in the provided metrics object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and metrics to default values.
